subject: MSA + Order Form: publicity / logo use redlines and confidentiality scope
messages:
From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@albatross.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Allison Reed <allison.reed@albatross.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MSA redlines — publicity & logo use

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team is excited. Attached are the redlines our legal team made to the MSA and Order Form annex (see Albatross_MSA_redlines.pdf and Proposed_OrderForm_Annex.docx). Two publicity items came up that I wanted to surface with you directly so we can align quickly:

1) Reference rights: we ask for an evergreen right to cite Albatross AI as a customer for marketing materials, plus the ability to use a short product quote from our CPO.
2) Logo use & escrow: procurement wants a signed logo-usage matrix and requests an escrow of a vector logo asset that they can publish on their site upon announcement.

They also added a 60-day embargo window in the Order Form (to coordinate joint press). Can your side confirm if those are acceptable or point us to the right person at Redwood to confirm scope / redline?

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we need legal signoff by next Wednesday to hit their Q3 announcement timeline.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Torres
Head of Partnerships, Albatross AI
Attachments: Albatross_MSA_redlines.pdf (PDF), Proposed_OrderForm_Annex.docx (DOCX)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MSA redlines — publicity & logo use

Hi Sam — thanks for sending these over and for the heads-up on timing. Looping in our legal & partnerships leads so we can respond with firm language. Quick clarifying questions before Connor takes point on redlines:

- When you refer to an "evergreen" reference right, is that intended to be unlimited in duration and scope (web/press/case study) or limited to product-level mentions only?
- For the logo escrow: do you need us to provide vectors to a shared drive, or does Albatross require an escrow mechanism held by a third party?
- Embargo: can you confirm whether the 60-day window is pre-announcement hold for both sides or unilateral from Albatross's side?

Connor / Markus — please see attachments and Sam's asks. If we can get suggested clause language back by EOD Tuesday (our time) I will coordinate a clean counter to Allison.

Irene Choi

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Allison Reed <allison.reed@albatross.ai>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@albatross.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:26:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Proposed MSA redlines — publicity & logo use

Team — forwarding Albatross's redlines. Key negotiation points I want us to take a clear stance on:

1) Reference rights: Albatross requests "evergreen" marketing rights + a product quote. We should push for a time-bounded reference right for customer logos and limit long-form case studies to mutual approval. Proposed negotiation position: allow web/press references and short quotes for 24 months with opt-out on specific quotes at signing.

2) Logo use / escrow: they are asking for an escrow. Standard for us is to provide usable logo files with brand guidelines; we do not use third-party escrow. If they need a mechanism to publish, we can provide a hosted asset with revocation control and an approval turn-around SLA.

3) Embargo: 60 days is long — product timelines differ. Recommend mutual-notice embargo capped at 30 days with the ability to request an extension in writing.

Please read the redlines (attached) and comment in-line. Monica — flag any customer success concerns about the proposed 24-month limit on quoting. Markus — this may impact partner messaging; advise. Connor — can you draft counter-language we can send to Allison?

FW: Attachment: Albatross_MSA_redlines.pdf

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@albatross.ai>, Allison Reed <allison.reed@albatross.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MSA redlines — publicity & logo use

All — thanks for the clear summary, Irene. Below are the edits I'm proposing (high level) so we're ready to send a clean counter to Allison this afternoon:

1) Reference rights: Acceptable limited grant: "Customer grants Redwood a non-exclusive, worldwide right to identify Customer as a customer of Redwood in marketing materials (website, press releases, product one-pagers) for a period of twenty-four (24) months following the Effective Date. Any testimonial or case study longer than 80 words requires Customer's prior written approval, not to be unreasonably withheld."

2) Product quotes: If Albatross provides an attributable quote, we will include an approval step: "Redwood will submit the final quote to Customer for approval within five (5) business days prior to publication."

3) Logo access / escrow: We will not agree to third-party escrow. Instead propose: "Customer will provide high-resolution logo assets and brand guidelines to Redwood via a secured shared storage with revocation controls. Redwood will not publish Customer logos without the logo usage approval process described in the Order Form."

4) Embargo: Propose mutual 30-day embargo with a one-time extension request: "The Parties will coordinate public announcements and agree to a mutual 30-day embargo prior to any public announcement. Either Party may request a one-time extension in writing; requests will not be unreasonably denied."

5) Signature / operational: Add an Order Form checklist table (logo file format, point of contact, approval SLA) — see logo_usage_matrix.xlsx.

If that aligns, I'll prepare a clean redline (accept/modify language) and send to Allison with an explanatory note offering the 24-month window as a compromise to their "evergreen" ask. Monica / Markus — let me know if the 24 months is a blocker for customer success or GTM.

Connor O'Brien
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
--
Attachment references: logo_usage_matrix.xlsx
